findings.description: The Mission's first repair cafe, a free community repair workshop, drew over 100 people to its debut in the living room of a Mission District housing co-op. The story names no address and states no building fact; the home is incidental to the event.

publish.note: No address, and a private home besides. A community workshop held in someone's living room is an event, not a fact about a building, and the root AGENTS.md's privacy limits would forbid the entry even if the address were given.

resolution.method: EAS exact match on 683 GEARY ST → parcel 0318016B; sf-parcels has blklot 0318016B active, 679–689 GEARY; the 2025 roll records it as multi-family residential, built 1916. EAS puts 679, 681, 683, 685, 687, 689 GEARY ST on that parcel, so per the directory contract the fact belongs on one page at the lowest, 679.

publish.note: The column's headline names no business, so it describes no building wrongly — but it also says nothing, and that is only worth a timeline line where the column reports a dated event that actually happened at the address. This one is an undated plan (“is opening another location”), which in ten years the headline would not help a reader with at all. Available when the opening is reported as done, or written up on its own.

findings.description: Warfield Commons at 988 Market Street — the former office building purchased by the Community Arts Stabilization Trust and KALW in February 2025 — holds its grand opening celebration on Sunday, September 27, with building tours including the People's Studio recording studio. The building now houses nonprofit and for-profit tenants including the Tenderloin Community Benefit District, San Francisco Public Press and Litquake.

extra.purchased: February 2025 by Community Arts Stabilization Trust and KALW

citation.label: Mission Local, “Tenderloin Buzz: Small businesses galore!,” 18 September 2026

raw.text: The Warfield Commons at 988 Market St. will hold a grand opening celebration on Sunday, Sept. 27, from noon to 5 p.m.

findings.note: One of several items in a Tenderloin business column; extracted as its own finding.

resolution.method: EAS exact match on 988 MARKET ST → parcel 0342018; sf-parcels has blklot 0342018 active, 982–982 MARKET; the 2025 roll records it as commercial retail. 988 MARKET ST's coordinates fall in 20 active parcels; 0342018 is the one with a page.

publish.note: An event listing. The grand-opening celebration on 27 September is a day at the building, not something that happened to it, and the building fact behind it — the 2025 purchase by CAST and KALW — is older news this column only recaps. Fails the ten-year test; the entry would also be a generic column headline carrying a future date.
